name: Standard Lithium Ltd.
upcoming_dates: 2026-09-29 | investor conference | Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference, Sep 29-30 2026, virtual | https://www.standardlithium.com/investors/events/ | primary
product: Battery-grade lithium carbonate (Li2CO3) for lithium-ion and LFP cathodes used in EVs and energy storage; buyers are LG Energy Solution (2026-08-31) and Trafigura (2026-09-28). End demand is the US domestic battery supply chain, validated by Nano One LFP CAM and cell testing 2026-08-13.
demand: Pre-revenue developer, so no current price or volume. Growth is volume and mix: SWA Phase 1 capacity 22500 t/yr (2026-09-28) plus Franklin 70000 t/yr (2026-09-08). Revenue begins 2029 (2026-09-28); contract pricing is index-linked (LGES contract effective 2026-08-27).
pricing_power: Project economics are most sensitive to the lithium carbonate selling price (2026-09-08 PEA), assumed flat at 22400 USD/t; a sustained carbonate price collapse would erase Franklin NPV and SWA returns. Capital overrun above the 1.45bn USD SWA CAPEX (2025-12-09) would also compress returns.
competition: Not found as a primary source. Context only: Chinese lithium carbonate from Qinghai/Tibet brine and hard-rock or mica is the low-cost substitute; it is commercially mature and geographically distant, so it competes on price rather than proximity. No primary price evidence located by 2026-09-28.
market_strategy: CEO David Park, 2026-09-28: our path forward is clear as we focus on finalizing and closing the Project financing, taking FID and beginning construction. And 2026-08-10: expectation remains to approve FID and begin construction at the SWA Project in 2026.
bull: Dated primary sources show offtakes exceeding the 80% target (LGES 8000 t/yr 2026-08-31; Trafigura 2026-09-28) and Franklin PEA NPV $5.0bn, IRR 24% (2026-09-08), de-risking demand and scale.
bear: Pre-revenue; ~$1.1bn debt package unclosed and FID still open as of 2026-09-28; Jefferies initiated Hold at $2.90 (2026-09-02); price 1.86, 21d momentum -28.7%; economics hinge on flat $22,400/t carbonate.
falsifier: No Final Investment Decision on the SWA Project announced by 2026-12-31, versus the company's 2026-09-28 target of FID later this year.
web_what_changed_30_90d: 30d: 2026-09-28 Trafigura offtake amended for +4000 t/yr option, total commitments 20000 of 22500 t/yr; 2026-09-11 board member Karen Narwold resigned; 2026-09-08 Franklin PEA NPV 5.0bn USD, IRR 24 percent; 2026-08-31 LG Energy Solution 8000 t/yr offtake. 90d: 2026-08-13 Nano One LFP cells; 2026-08-10 Q2 results, NEPA FONSI, two construction contracts.
web_true_now_not_modelled: Franklin PEA published 2026-09-08 adds a second 70000 t/yr project (after-tax NPV8 5.0bn USD) beyond SWA, which sell-side initiations may not yet model. And the 2026-09-28 offtake amendments lift possible commitments to 20000 of 22500 t/yr, above the 80 percent target, leaving only debt close before FID.
web_demand_product: Battery-grade lithium carbonate (Li2CO3) for lithium-ion and LFP cathodes used in EVs and energy storage; buyers are LG Energy Solution (2026-08-31) and Trafigura (2026-09-28). End demand is the US domestic battery supply chain, validated by Nano One LFP CAM and cell testing 2026-08-13.
web_price_volume_mix: Pre-revenue developer, so no current price or volume. Growth is volume and mix: SWA Phase 1 capacity 22500 t/yr (2026-09-28) plus Franklin 70000 t/yr (2026-09-08). Revenue begins 2029 (2026-09-28); contract pricing is index-linked (LGES contract effective 2026-08-27).
web_bottleneck: Company bottleneck is project financing and FID: a senior secured debt package of about 1.1bn USD remains unclosed as of 2026-09-28 despite three ECAs in due diligence (2025-12-09). It relieves the US domestic battery-grade lithium and midstream CAM supply gap (2026-08-13).
web_who_benefits_next: Second-order: EPC contractors S and B and Wood, which hold Limited Notices to Proceed (2026-08-10); Equinor, the 45 percent JV partner (2026-09-28); Nano One, the CAM maker (2026-08-13). Third-order: US cell makers, DOE (225m USD grant, 2025-12-09) and Arkansas/Texas wellfield services.
web_who_loses: Aggregator context only, no primary source found: incumbent Chinese lithium carbonate producers and converters, and rival Smackover and US direct-lithium-extraction developers, lose if low-cost US domestic battery-grade carbonate displaces imported material.
web_margin_collapse_risk: Project economics are most sensitive to the lithium carbonate selling price (2026-09-08 PEA), assumed flat at 22400 USD/t; a sustained carbonate price collapse would erase Franklin NPV and SWA returns. Capital overrun above the 1.45bn USD SWA CAPEX (2025-12-09) would also compress returns.
web_low_cost_substitute: Not found as a primary source. Context only: Chinese lithium carbonate from Qinghai/Tibet brine and hard-rock or mica is the low-cost substitute; it is commercially mature and geographically distant, so it competes on price rather than proximity. No primary price evidence located by 2026-09-28.
web_ceo_promised: CEO David Park, 2026-09-28: our path forward is clear as we focus on finalizing and closing the Project financing, taking FID and beginning construction. And 2026-08-10: expectation remains to approve FID and begin construction at the SWA Project in 2026.
web_did_they_deliver: Partly. Two of four pre-FID deliverables, NEPA FONSI plus two construction contracts, were completed per 2026-08-10 Q2 results, and the 2026-08-31 and 2026-09-28 offtakes exceed the 80 percent target. Project financing close and the FID decision itself remain outstanding as of 2026-09-28.
web_what_would_falsify: No Final Investment Decision on the SWA Project announced by 2026-12-31, against the 2026-09-28 target of FID later this year; or an equity raise priced below USD 2.06 before FID; or a lithium carbonate price sustained below the 22400 USD/t assumption used in the 2026-09-08 Franklin PEA.
